issues.description: Inconsistent type specified for the field Animal.name across artifacts. The UML in problem_statement.md declares the attribute as 'name: String' (problem_statement.md lines 26-28). The textual task description in the same problem statement explicitly instructs implementers to use a StringBuilder for the name attribute for performance (problem_statement.md lines 84-86). The reference solution declares the field as a String (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Animal.java line 4: 'private String name;'). This contradiction leaves students unclear whether to implement Animal.name as java.lang.String or java.lang.StringBuilder, which affects the constructor, getter/setter behavior, and how other classes concatenate or print the name.
